title: The fields shown are recorded once per display per session
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. On the Work Orders QA build with Google Analytics enabled for the org and a way to observe the events fired (browser devtools Network tab, or engineering/dev support).
  4. Ensure the location has eligible lead technicians and work orders so the displays and fields can be exercised.
  5. A user with see-financial-data and a user without; analytics observation available.
custom_steps:
1. Load the page and confirm one field-exposure event per available field, including untouched defaults and restored preferences.
  2. As the user without see-financial-data, confirm financial fields are not sent and are excluded from the exposure denominator.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The analytics snapshot of selected and unselected fields available to the user (including untouched defaults and restored preferences) is recorded once per display per session, the first time the user opens that display that session, not on every open.
  • Field changes are still recorded each time they are saved; unavailable financial fields are excluded.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10593 — Google Analytics for display and field usage. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S12-R2, S12-R7 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R2: “Measure selected and unselected fields available to each user, including untouched defaults and restored preferences. Record this snapshot once per display per session, the first time the user opens that display in the session, not on every open. Field changes are still recorded each time they are saved (S12-R3).”
  • S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.”
